method: Agent visual interpretation of native scan and NSTDB topology; manual source pixel placement. No trained matcher or extraction masks used. Printed graticule supplies search area only.
prior_exposure: The same agent previously inspected this sheet and some saved controls. Saved hand-correction files and warped imagery were not reopened for this test before this freeze; this is not a pristine blind evaluation.
context_check_limit: These correspondences informed visual selection of T. They are held out from the one-point translation, not independent operator annotations or untouched selection holdouts.

pre_scoring_gate.scope: Pass supports only this local candidate. It does not authorize replacing a sheet warp or establish surveyed accuracy.
